key_insight: GWDM combines wavelet-based diffusion with histopathology-specific guidance to generate realistic tissue image patches for training-data augmentation.
clinical_relevance: Synthetic patches improved nuclei and tissue segmentation in reported experiments, suggesting potential value for research on data-limited pathology AI.
method: Uses wavelets to capture image details at multiple scales.
Conditions generation on tissue patterns and staining variations.
Gradually introduces histomorphological guidance, including perceptual and structural similarity losses, to stabilize training.
evidence_signal: Across BCSS, MoNuSeg, and PAIP2019, the abstract reports better synthesis than state-of-the-art comparators and improved segmentation when synthetic images augmented real training data.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical effect sizes or prospective clinical validation, so deployment benefits remain unestablished.
paper_title: GWDM: A Guided Wavelet Diffusion Model for Realistic Histopathology Image Generation
